title: Shadow-Consistent Semi-Supervised Learning for Prostate Ultrasound Segmentation

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Shadow-Consistent Semi-Supervised Learning for Prostate Ultrasound Segmentation》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Prostate segmentation in transrectal ultrasound (TRUS) image is an essential prerequisite for many prostate-related clinical procedures, which, however, is also a long-standing problem due to the challenges caused by the low image quality and shadow artifacts.

evidence.text: Prostate segmentation in transrectal ultrasound (TRUS) image is an essential prerequisite for many prostate-related clinical procedures, which, however, is also a long-standing problem due to the challenges caused by the low image quality and shadow artifacts.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Specifically, Shadow-AUG enriches training samples by adding simulated shadow artifacts to the images to make the network robust to the shadow patterns.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】In the semi-supervised setting, even with only 20% labeled training data, our SCO-SSL method still achieves highly competitive performance, suggesting great clinical value in relieving the labor of data annotation.

evidence.text: Specifically, Shadow-AUG enriches training samples by adding simulated shadow artifacts to the images to make the network robust to the shadow patterns.

In the semi-supervised setting, even with only 20% labeled training data, our SCO-SSL method still achieves highly competitive performance, suggesting great clinical value in relieving the labor of data annotation.
